title: Complete Wash and Rest Equipment Display
description: One complete static pet-care equipment display scene, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. The full original raised grooming wash station occupies the rear-left zone, one complete original hard-shell carrier stands separately at front-left, and the full original cubby-and-offset-perch climbing frame occupies the right zone. One low continuous scene-only floor joins these unequal station positions with visibly open intervening areas, not a shelf of repeated crates or a renamed human waiting area. Every original raw GLB buffer, local POSITION/NORMAL, material dictionary, per-face assignment and internal hierarchy is retained byte-exact; only declared whole-assembly translations at unit scale are added. No original geometry is extracted, cropped, rescaled or recoloured. Static unoccupied equipment exhibit only: no animals, working wash/plumbing, usable climbing route, animal/species fit, hygienic workflow, safety zoning, real facility planning, load/stability/welfare/manufacture or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
